description:
## Symptom

`fixtures2/00430_opaque_value_accessor.fz` (a module `A` with `@type t :: opaque resource(integer)`, `def get(h :: t), do: h.value`, and `main` calling `A.get(A.make())`):

- `fz2 run` prints `7`.
- `fz2 interp` fails: `function_clause: no backend entry clause matched for executable ExecutableKey { ... }`.

Three-path parity is broken on the interp leg.

## Reduction (measured at 4fca80802, fz2 debug build)

- Drop the annotation (`def get(h)`): interp prints 7.
- Drop `opaque` (`@type t :: resource(integer)`): interp prints 7.

So the backend interpreter's entry-clause test for a parameter typed as an opaque resource rejects a value of that type. The JIT accepts it.

## Found by

fz-p8p census: the only test that drives 00430 (`port_planner_test.rs::opaque_value_accessor_inside_declaring_module_types_as_inner`) asserts only that the drive resolves, so the runtime failure was never observed. Once 00430 runs on the fixture matrix it is red on interp; this ticket is the fix.
title: The backend interpreter rejects an argument annotated with an opaque resource type
